narr: A warm front lifted north into the Mid-South during the morning hours of August 9, 2023. An upper-level trough moving into the region interacted with this front to produce numerous showers and thunderstorms from northeast Arkansas during the late morning shifting east-southeast into southwest Tennessee and northeast Mississippi during the early afternoon. Along and south of the front surface-base convective available potential energy values increased to 1500 J/kg due to surface heating while mid-level lapse rates steepened. A few severe storms developed along the warm front resulting in damaging winds, hail, and flash flooding across southwest Tennessee and northeast Mississippi.
